test_title: PYST 02: SSC JE ME - General Awareness (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: On 26 July 2023, Tenzing Yangki created history in Arunachal Pradesh by achieving a prestigious UPSC rank and becoming the state's first female __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Police Service Officer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tenzing Yangki** created history in **Arunachal Pradesh** by achieving a prestigious **UPSC rank**.
 
• She became the state's first female **Indian Police Service (IPS) Officer** on **26 July 2023**.
 
• The **Indian Police Service (IPS)** is one of the three All India Services of the Government of India.
 
• IPS officers play a crucial role in maintaining public order, law enforcement, and crime prevention.
 
• Their duties include leading and commanding the police force in the state and union territories, maintaining peace, and ensuring the safety of the citizens.
 
• IPS officers are selected through the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** Civil Services Examination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Revenue Officer**__

 __
 
• A **Revenue Officer** is responsible for the administration of revenue collection, land records, and related functions in their jurisdiction.
 
• They work under the Department of Revenue in the state government.
 
 
 
• **Education Commissioner**__
 __
 
• An **Education Commissioner** oversees the administration and implementation of educational policies and programs in a state or region.
 
• They ensure the quality and standards of education are maintained.
 
 
 
• **Indian Administrative Service Officer**__
 
 
• An **Indian Administrative Service (IAS) Officer** is a key part of the Indian bureaucracy responsible for the administration and governance of the country.
 
• IAS officers implement government policies and manage public sector undertakings.
